review_en: It has disappointed me very much. I placed an order online 10 days ago and I still haven't received it, I had no idea it could take so long. Of course, I won't buy anything else from them. There are better products in the competition, such as druni or primor that have a better quality-price ratio and of course the delivery time for online orders is much faster. review_original: kiko cosmetics è uno di quei marchi che ti conquista subito. offre prodotti di qualità sorprendente a prezzi accessibili, con una scelta enorme che va dal make‑up alla skincare. molti clienti apprezzano la durata dei mascara, la pigmentazione degli ombretti e la resa dei rossetti, spesso paragonati a marchi molto più costosi. anche l’esperienza in negozio viene descritta in modo molto positivo: personale preparato, disponibile e capace di consigliare davvero ciò che serve. è un brand italiano che negli anni si è costruito una reputazione solida grazie a innovazione, sicurezza dei prodotti e attenzione ai dettagli. per chi cerca qualità senza spendere troppo, kiko è una scelta che difficilmente delude.
review_en: kiko cosmetics is one of those brands that wins you over immediately. offers amazing quality products at affordable prices, with a huge choice ranging from make-up to skincare. many customers appreciate the durability of the mascaras, the pigmentation of the eyeshadows and the performance of the lipsticks, often compared to much more expensive brands. the in-store experience is also described in a very positive way: trained staff, available and able to really recommend what you need. is an Italian brand that has built a solid reputation over the years thanks to innovation, product safety and attention to detail. for those looking for quality without spending too much, kiko is a choice that is unlikely to disappoint.

review_original: alcuni dei prodotti kiko non sono male ma altri aspetti del brand sono da bocciare: innanzitutto le commesse insistenti a dismisura, a tratti maleducate e irrispettose e sarà una prerogativa durante la selezione del personale perchè ho riscontrato la stessa cosa in diversi punti vendita in città differenti. prezzi che aumentano vertiginosamente nel giro di un paio di mesi e, a volte, la mancanza di corrispodenza del numero di un prodotto da un acquisto a quello successivo.
review_en: some of the kiko products are not bad but other aspects of the brand are to be rejected: first of all the excessively insistent sales assistants, at times rude and disrespectful and this will be a prerogative during the selection of staff because I found the same thing in different stores in different cities. prices that skyrocket within a couple of months and, sometimes, the mismatch of a product number from one purchase to the next.

platja d’aro shop

review_original:
j’ai passé commande le 11 mars et je n’ai eu aucune nouvelle pendant plusieurs jours (environ 5 jours), ma commande restant simplement “en préparation”.

j’ai donc contacté le service client, en fournissant pourtant dès le départ mon numéro de commande et mon nom. 

malgré cela, on m’a demandé de nombreuses informations supplémentaires : captures d’écran de la commande, preuve de paiement paypal, etc.
le processus est très lourd et peu fluide pour une commande à moins de 50 euros.

de plus, on m’a indiqué que je n’écrivais pas depuis la “bonne adresse email”, ce qui a encore compliqué la situation et retardé l’accès aux informations.

après 5 échanges de mails, je n’avais toujours aucune réponse concrète à ma question principale : quand ma commande allait-elle être expédiée ?

en parallèle, je me suis aperçue que côté paypal, le paiement était toujours en “autorisation en cours”, donc non validé par kiko, ce qui n’était jamais clairement expliqué.

avant-hier, j’ai relancé une nouvelle fois avec mon autre mail.

on m’a répondu que la commande était “en préparation”, alors que sur le site elle apparaissait expédiée, avec un numéro de suivi non fonctionnel.

finalement, j’ai reçu ma commande 2 jours plus tard, donc la livraison a été rapide une fois expédiée.

en résumé : 

produits conformes et livraison efficace, mais expérience client à améliorer :

manque de transparence sur le statut réel des commandes

communication confuse

processus de support lourd et répétitif

en espérant que cela s'améliore nettement.

un groupe whatsapp sav serait bien apprécié en 2026.
review_en:
I placed an order on March 11 and had no news for several days (around 5 days), my order simply remaining “in preparation”.

I therefore contacted customer service, although providing my order number and name from the start. 

despite this, I was asked for a lot of additional information: screenshots of the order, proof of PayPal payment, etc.
the process is very cumbersome and not very smooth for an order costing less than 50 euros.

in addition, I was told that I was not writing from the “correct email address”, which further complicated the situation and delayed access to information.

after 5 email exchanges, I still had no concrete answer to my main question: when was my order going to be shipped?

at the same time, I noticed that on the Paypal side, the payment was still in “authorization in progress”, therefore not validated by kiko, which was never clearly explained.

The day before yesterday, I launched again with my other email.

I was told that the order was “in preparation”, even though on the site it appeared shipped, with a non-functional tracking number.

Ultimately, I received my order 2 days later, so delivery was quick once shipped.

in summary: 

compliant products and efficient delivery, but customer experience needs improvement:

lack of transparency on the real status of orders

confusing communication

cumbersome and repetitive support process

hoping that it improves significantly.

a whatsapp after-sales group would be much appreciated in 2026.

review_original:
hice un pedido a las 23:00 del 15 de febrero, dentro del periodo de descuento de san valentín (del 12 al 15 de febrero). en teoría, la promoción debía terminar a las 23:59 del 15 de febrero.

sin embargo, tras realizar el pedido, este fue cancelado diez minutos después. al actualizar la página web a las 23:10, el descuento de san valentín ya había desaparecido.

me parece una práctica engañosa, ya que la promoción supuestamente estaba vigente hasta medianoche, pero en realidad dejó de aplicarse antes. contacté con atención al cliente y me dijeron que nadie lo había denunciado anteriormente.

en cualquier caso, esta experiencia me ha decepcionado bastante. 

en fin, me ahorré 120 euros y kiko milano perdió una venta. mi marido se lo agradecerá.
review_en:
I placed an order at 11:00 p.m. on February 15, within the Valentine's Day discount period (February 12 to 15). In theory, the promotion was supposed to end at 11:59 p.m. on February 15.

However, after placing the order, it was canceled ten minutes later. When I updated the website at 11:10 p.m., the Valentine's Day discount had already disappeared.

It seems like a deceptive practice to me, since the promotion was supposedly valid until midnight, but in reality it stopped applying before. I contacted customer service and they told me that no one had reported it before.

In any case, this experience has disappointed me quite a bit. 

Anyway, I saved 120 euros and Kiko Milano lost a sale. my husband will thank you.

I bombarded them with emails until finally after a month I was refunded. ich habe 2024 beim black friday die 3+3 aktion genutzt und etliche artikel online bestellt. leider waren drei davon bereits benutzt/ausgelaufen, weswegen ich umgehend den kundenservice kontaktierte. die reklamation lief semi-zufriedenstellend. ich hätte entweder die gesamte bestellung zurücksenden müssen, oder konnte alternativ einen shopgutschein i.h.v 30€ akzeptieren. ich entschied mich für den gutschein, da ich die übrigen artikel gern behalten wollte und teilweise dann selbst schon in benutzung hatte. der gutscheincode kam in textform per mail bei mir an.

die antwort in ungefähren worten: "ihr gutschein wurde bereits erfolgreich eingelöst, daher ist eine erneute nutzung nicht möglich." 
auch nach dem dritten mal nachfragen und bitten, habe ich immer wieder die gleiche, nichtssagende antwort erhalten. 
kurz: mangelhafte produkte erhalten, keine erstattung sondern einen gutschein für den shop bekommen, welchen ich am ende nicht nutzen konnte und keinerlei hilfe vom kundenservice erhalten.
nee, das muss ich nicht noch einmal haben.
review_en:
I took advantage of the 3+3 promotion on Black Friday in 2024 and ordered a number of items online. Unfortunately, three of them had already been used/expired, which is why I immediately contacted customer service. The complaint was semi-satisfactory. I would have either had to return the entire order, or alternatively I could accept a shop voucher worth €30. I decided on the voucher because I wanted to keep the remaining items and had already used some of them myself. The voucher code arrived in text form by email.
Fast forward to BF 2025 - another 3+3 promotion and I wanted to redeem my €30 voucher because it was only supposed to be valid for one year and would have expired two or three weeks later anyway. Unfortunately, I was promptly informed that the code was not valid. I tried it several times - impossible, so I immediately contacted customer service again and asked how that could be. At first I got the rather general answer that some codes couldn't be combined with certain promotions, etc. As I understand it, that doesn't make any sense in this case, because this is a means of payment, not a code that would deduct percentages from the price. A little later I received an email saying that the check revealed that the code had already been used. strange because I haven't placed an order in over a year. I asked to be told when, by whom and for which order my voucher was supposed to have been redeemed and pointed out that the last activity in my customer account was longer than I even have the voucher code.
The answer in approximate terms: "Your voucher has already been successfully redeemed, so it is not possible to use it again." 
Even after asking and asking for the third time, I kept getting the same, meaningless answer. 
In short: received defective products, no refund but a voucher for the shop, which I couldn't use in the end and received no help from customer service.
No, I don't have to have that again.

je fais appel à une seconde vendeuse qui me confirme la rupture de stock du n° 18. lui montrant l’info sur mon téléphone, elle va tout de même vérifier en réserve mais pense que l’info sur mon téléphone est erronée. 
elle revient avec une boite et en plus, en ouvrant le tiroir sous le présentoir, constate qu’il y avait déjà une boîte pleine de crayon du n° 18 !
ok, j’ai donc trouvé l’article recherché mais fais simplement remarquer lors du paiement que si le stock avait été à jour cela m’aurait évité de risquer de repartir sans mon achat et surtout de venir de loin pour rien.

review_en:
I spoke to a first saleswoman from the Kiko boutique in the Valette du Var shopping center yesterday to buy an unlimited precision eyeliner n°18. the latter tells me that No. 18 is out of stock, which is why the tester pencil has a small sticker.
I look on my phone to see where I can find this pencil nearby and see that it is advertised as being available in the Kiko store in Valletta.
I call a second saleswoman who confirms that No. 18 is out of stock. Showing her the information on my phone, she still goes to check in stock but thinks that the information on my phone is incorrect. 
she comes back with a box and what's more, when she opens the drawer under the display, she notices that there was already a box full of No. 18 pencils!
ok, so I found the item I was looking for but simply point out when paying that if the stock had been up to date this would have saved me from the risk of leaving without my purchase and especially from coming from far away for nothing.
the cashier tells me “that’s not my problem”
unacceptable!!! First of all, they miss out on sales by not checking stock, but on top of that they are contemptuous of customers.

utilizzando due di questi rossetti, mi accorgo che uno dei due ha la chiusura difettata. premetto che il packaging è il tratto distintivo di questo rossetto.
quindi mi reco in negozio per contestare il problema e con fare piuttosto supponente, la "gentilissima" commessa mi dice che non si può effettuare il cambio del prodotto difettoso perché fa parte di una promozione che prevede la restituzione dei sei articoli acquistati e cosa ancora più assurda la presenza dello scatolino del famigerato rossetto.

ho dato una stella perché di meno non si può.

I went to the Palermo Forum store to buy a new lipstick. I didn't need anything else, however, I let myself be drawn in by the order which enticed me to join the 3+3 "promotion".
with difficulty, I manage to choose 5 remaining products which include 3 lipsticks from the one magic touch collection.
using two of these lipsticks, I notice that one of them has a defective closure. I'll start by saying that the packaging is the distinctive feature of this lipstick.
so I go to the store to dispute the problem and rather arrogantly, the "very kind" sales assistant tells me that it is not possible to exchange the defective product because it is part of a promotion that provides for the return of the six items purchased and what is even more absurd is the presence of the box of the infamous lipstick.
therefore, they did not solve a problem for me and, as if that were not enough, they would have created another one for me, demanding the presence of other articles, which were requested in vain.
when I objected, saying that at the time of purchase I had not been told that in the event of any returns it would be mandatory to return everything back, the lady sales assistant elegantly "shrugged"...
hats off to the company's seriousness...
I gave it one star because you can't do less.

hace un tiempo fui a la tienda de kiko en un centro comercial de santander (cantabria), me compré un eyeliner líquido de color negro, al día siguiente me lo aplique en una fina linea sobre el párpado superior e inmediatamente me provocó un escozor insoportable y me lo tuve que retirar, a los dos días tenía una conjuntivitis en el ojo impresionante y se me extendió al otro ojo.
al no informar a mi hermana de lo que ocurrió al día siguiente mi hermana se aplicó el producto en el ojo y le produjo el mismo picor y escozor insoportable que a mi.
yo no soy una persona que compre maquillaje habitualmente ya que no me suelo maquillar...pero confíe en la tienda de kiko y para un producto que compro y era tóxico noo, lo siguiente.
review_en:
A while ago I went to the Kiko store in a shopping center in Santander (Cantabria), I bought a black liquid eyeliner, the next day I applied it in a thin line on the upper eyelid and it immediately caused an unbearable sting and I had to remove it, two days later I had impressive conjunctivitis in my eye and it spread to the other eye.
By not informing my sister of what happened the next day, my sister applied the product to her eye and it caused the same unbearable itching and burning as me.
I am not a person who buys makeup regularly since I don't usually wear makeup...but I trusted the Kiko store and for a product that I bought and it was toxic noo, the following.

review_original: ho ordinato una gift card sul sito di kiko il 22 novembre. partiamo dal principio: all'interno dell'ordine configurano anche altri prodotti che erano stati rimossi dal carrello prima di proseguire con il pagamento. questi prodotti risultano con importo 0€ e quantità 0 ma comunque rientrano nel computo dei prodotti dell'ordine (ma non nell'importo). primo segnale d'allarme che mi ha fatto comprendere dell'esistenza di un bug sul loro sito. inoltre, l'ordine è ancora bloccato allo stato "confermato". avendo scelto klarna come metodo di pagamento non mi hanno ancora scalato l'importo della gift card acquistata perché non è arrivata alcuna email di conferma dell'ordine. purtuttavia, essendo un regalo, ovviamente non è arrivato al destinatario. dopo un mese è tutto ancora fermo immobile. il servizio clienti è incontattabile e le faq di alcun aiuto. non acquisterò mai più dall'e-commerce di kiko ma gradirei ricevere assistenza per annullare l'ordine, visto che non è possibile procedere in tal senso sul sito.
review_en: I ordered a gift card on the Kiko website on November 22nd. Let's start from the beginning: within the order they also configure other products that had been removed from the cart before continuing with the payment. these products have an amount of €0 and quantity of 0 but are still included in the calculation of the products of the order (but not in the amount). first warning sign that made me realize there was a bug on their site. furthermore, the order is still stuck in the "confirmed" state. having chosen klarna as my payment method, they have not yet deducted the amount of the gift card purchased because no order confirmation email has arrived. however, being a gift, it obviously did not reach the recipient. after a month everything is still standing still. the customer service is uncontactable and the FAQ of no help. I will never purchase from Kiko's e-commerce again but I would like assistance in canceling the order, given that it is not possible to do so on the site.

review_original: ayer fui a la tienda del cc aljub y compré varios productos.uno de ellos el unlimited doble touch.cuando elegi el color que me gustó,le pedí a una de las dependientas que me diera el color correspondiente porque en el tester el número estaba borrado.me dio uno y yo me fié de ella porque suponía que sabía que color era.cuando llegue a casa lo abrí y no era el color que yo había elegido.he ido esta tarde a cambiarlo y me han dicho que como esta abierto no me lo pueden cambiar por normas de higiene.yo le he dicho que eso lo entiendo pero que el error es de ellas y lo tienen que subsanar.me ha dicho que "el color se ve perfectamente por fuera y que un error lo puede tener cualquiera".¡claro que un error lo puede tener cualquiera!,pero yo cuando cometo un error en mi trabajo,lo arreglo yo y no se lo hago pagar a la clienta.y el color no se ve perfectamente por fuera,eso lo primero,y lo segundo es que yo iba confiada de que la chica me había dado mi color y lógicamente no me puse a revisarlo.fue al abrirlo cuando me di cuenta y por supuestisimo que no lo usé.entiendo las normas de higiene,pero coges mi labial,lo tiras a la basura y me das el que yo había supuestamente comprado.que cada vez que voy,tanto al aljub como a la zenia,me dejo un dineral.que esa es otra,que no se verá reflejado todo lo que compro,porque hasta ayer se ve que no habían tenido a bien hacerme ficha.muy descontenta y muy enfadada. desde luego que no voy a volver a comprar en estas tiendas.
review_en: Yesterday I went to the CC Aljub store and bought several products. One of them was the unlimited double touch. When I chose the color I liked, I asked one of the shop assistants to give me the corresponding color because the number was erased on the tester. She gave me one and I trusted her because I assumed she knew what color it was. When I got home I opened it and it was not the color I had chosen. I went this afternoon to change it and they told me that since it is open they cannot change it due to rules of hygiene. I told her that I understand that but that the mistake is theirs and they have to correct it. She told me that "the color looks perfectly on the outside and that anyone can make a mistake." Of course anyone can make a mistake! But when I make a mistake in my work, I fix it myself and I don't make the client pay for it. And the color doesn't look perfect on the outside, that's the first thing, and the second thing is that I was confident that the girl had given me my color and Logically, I didn't start to review it. It was when I opened it that I realized and of course I didn't use it. I understand the hygiene rules, but you take my lipstick, throw it in the trash and give me the one that I had supposedly bought. Every time I go, both to the aljub and to the zenia, I leave a fortune. That's another thing, that not everything I buy will be reflected, because until yesterday it was clear that they had not seen fit to make me tab.very dissatisfied and very angry. I certainly won't buy from these stores again.

Today I was at Kiko at Conca d'Oro and I went in because I was convinced I had to choose another foundation but a very cute girl named Maria Elena was listening to me... she wanted to deepen her research in the warehouse and unbelievable she found a whole box which obviously taking advantage of the 3+3 I took immediately. accidents can happen but at least respond within 24/48 hours but yes, it would be nice since I paid for products that didn't arrive. I had to send three threatening emails and open a dispute to receive a response 24 hours after the last email. refund within twenty working days. We will see

mein besuch im kiko-milano-store in düsseldorf war leider ein klarer tiefpunkt in sachen kundenservice. ich wollte drei artikel aus einer online-bestellung zurückgeben – etwas, das laut kiko-richtlinien problemlos möglich sein sollte. die zuständige mitarbeiterin zeigte jedoch von beginn an ein ausgesprochen unfreundliches, abweisendes und wenig professionelles verhalten.

sie bestand ausschließlich auf einem qr-code, der trotz korrekt durchgeführtem rückgabeprozess überhaupt nicht generiert wurde. anstatt sich dem problem anzunehmen oder eine alternative lösung zu suchen, wirkte sie sichtlich genervt, dauerhaft mit ihrem handy beschäftigt und offenbar primär daran interessiert, mich so schnell wie möglich wieder loszuwerden. die schlechte internetverbindung im store machte es zusätzlich unmöglich, meine unterlagen erneut abzurufen.

am ende verließ ich den store ohne jegliche unterstützung und mit dem eindruck, dass kund:innen hier eher abgefertigt als beraten werden. ein solches verhalten ist für eine internationale marke wie kiko milano absolut inakzeptabel und untergräbt das vertrauen in den gesamten kundenservice.

ich kann diesen store aufgrund meiner erfahrung derzeit nicht weiterempfehlen.
review_en:
Unfortunately, my visit to the Kiko Milano store in Düsseldorf was a clear low point in terms of customer service. I wanted to return three items from an online order - something that according to Kiko guidelines should be possible without any problems. However, the employee in charge showed extremely unfriendly, dismissive and unprofessional behavior from the start.

She insisted solely on a QR code, which was not generated at all despite the return process being carried out correctly. Instead of addressing the problem or looking for an alternative solution, she seemed visibly annoyed, constantly busy with her cell phone and obviously primarily interested in getting rid of me as quickly as possible. The poor internet connection in the store also made it impossible to access my documents again.

In the end, I left the store without any support and with the impression that customers were being processed here rather than advised. Such behavior is absolutely unacceptable for an international brand like Kiko Milano and undermines trust in the entire customer service.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this store at the moment.

ad oggi tale mission non esiste più. i prezzi hanno assunto rincari vertiginosi, e se alcuni prodotti mi soddisfacevano sono ormai costretta a rinunciarvi.
le promo sono uno specchio per allodole: solo se compri 4 (con il 3+1) o 6 (con il 3+3) articoli hai diritto a scontistiche. e se io mi trucco poco e necessito solo di un paio di cose?
review_en:

today this mission no longer exists. prices have risen dramatically, and if some products satisfied me I am now forced to give them up.
the promos are a decoy: only if you buy 4 (with the 3+1) or 6 (with the 3+3) items you are entitled to discounts. What if I wear little makeup and only need a couple of things?

vorrei segnalare la poca correttezza di questa azienda...
mia figlia di 13 anni trova una gift card regalatale in passato ma senza ricordare di preciso in quale occasione e quando e poiché sulla card non c'è scritta nessuna data né di acquisto né di scadenza,ma solo un foglio di regolamento in cui si parla di validità di 1 anno,io stamattina 16/11/25 mi reco nel negozio di modena presso centro commerciale grande emilia a chiedere sia valore che data scadenza della suddetta gift card..
mi viene risposto che la card è scaduta giorno 4/11/25..quindi da ben 12 giorni!!!
alla mia richiesta di poter risolvere in qualche modo, perché la card aveva 50€ di valore mi viene risposto "assolutamente no!!!"
allora faccio notare alle commesse e a tutti voi che nn è proprio corretto dare una scadenza che cmq non è specificata da nessuna parte sulla gift (io pur sapendo che vale un anno, nn posso sapere quando sia stata emessa se nn è scritto da nessuna parte data acquisto o scadenza!!!), incassando cmq dei soldi che una scadenza nn l'hanno..
la commessa mi risponde che loro i soldi nn li avrebbero ancora incassati..dimostrandosi pure molto incompetente..
ora,nn tanto per i 50€ ma è per dire che un'azienda si perda per tanto poco(ricordo inoltre che parliamo di scadenza da poco più di 10gg !!!) , dimostrando di essere nn proprio trasparente ,incassando soldi senza dare nessun prodotto.
non ci tornerò mai più e sicuramente la pubblicità non sarà positiva da parte mia...
peccato...
review_en:
I would like to point out the lack of correctness of this company...
my 13 year old daughter finds a gift card given to her in the past but without remembering exactly on which occasion and when and since there is no purchase or expiry date written on the card, but only a regulation sheet which talks about validity of 1 year, this morning 11/16/25 I go to the Modena shop at the Grande Emilia shopping center to ask for both the value and expiry date of the aforementioned gift card..
I was told that the card expired on 4/11/25...so 12 days ago!!!
to my request to be able to resolve it in some way, because the card had a value of €50, I was told "absolutely not!!!"
then I point out to the sales assistants and to all of you that it is not really correct to give a deadline which is not specified anywhere on the gift (even though I know that it is valid for one year, I cannot know when it was issued if the date of purchase or expiry is not written anywhere!!!), still collecting money which does not have a deadline..
the sales assistant replies to me that they wouldn't have received the money yet.. also proving to be very incompetent..
now, not so much for the €50 but it is to say that a company loses itself for so little (I also remember that we are talking about expiry just over 10 days!!!), proving to be not exactly transparent, collecting money without giving any product.
I will never go back there again and the publicity will certainly not be positive on my part...
too bad...

review_original:
i worked at kiko milano and it was one of the most unpleasant job experiences i’ve ever had. since the current manager took over (she knows exactly who she is), the store’s environment completely changed for the worse. within less than a year, five girls left because of her behaviour. she constantly bullied and singled out staff, especially one colleague who was picked on purely because her makeup and style were different.

this manager made inappropriate and unprofessional comments, acted immaturely for someone in her position, and often gossiped about staff — even while they were working. it created an extremely toxic, uncomfortable, and tense atmosphere where no one felt safe or respected. for someone in her 40s, her behaviour was shockingly childish and unprofessional.

the area manager only made things worse by covering for her and refusing to address the bullying, even when several staff members raised concerns. hr doesn’t care either — you’re treated as disposable and easily replaceable, no matter how loyal or hardworking you are.

one staff member who had been with kiko for over three years left within a month of this manager arriving. two new hires also didn’t last — one immediately looked for another job and left as soon as she found one, and the other was led on for months, promised a permanent contract that never came, and eventually quit after being lied to repeatedly. also - she was originally a beauty advisor but got promoted to keyholder. she was not paid extra as she took on more responsibilities - but was also under age. there were two other girls who could have become keyholders but due to childish grudges the manager held - she decided to overwhelm this 17 year old girl with these responsibilities.

the only positive thing about the job was the rest of the team — genuinely lovely girls who tried to support one another through all the negativity. but even that couldn’t make up for the toxicity and lack of accountability at management level.

however, as soon as i placed the order i saw that their system had completely removed half of my address...the half with my flat number and building name.

i eventually found how to contact customer service, which can only be done by filling in a form, and then is completely via email. i contacted them right away, but it took them days to get back to me, by which point my order had been shipped. i was able to add a note to the tracking to say where to deliver if no one is home, but i used my actual address hoping it would get to me.

however, kiko also contacted royal mail, and this seemed to just get my package returned to them...however they are claiming it was delivered to me, so now i will most likely have to file a dispute with my credit card company to get my money back.

i wish i had never ordered from kiko milano cosmetics, and would advise others to avoid them at all costs!

save yourself the headache, and buy from a reputable company that has proper customer service.

review_original:
je me suis présentée à la boutique kiko milano de saint-priest (auchan – porte des alpes), flambant neuve, avec l’intention de réaliser un achat conséquent pour moi et pour un cadeau collectif.
à 18h41, alors que la boutique était grande ouverte (rideau non baissé, portes accessibles, aucun client à l’intérieur), la vendeuse m’a dit en souriant : « je suis en train de fermer la caisse, désolée madame, on est fermé ». pourtant, les horaires officiels affichés sur le site de kiko, indiquent une fermeture à 20h00.

en tant que cliente fidèle, habituée à faire des achats importants chez kiko, je trouve cela incompréhensible et décevant. cette expérience m’a définitivement dissuadée de fréquenter cette boutique.
review_en:
I went to the Kiko Milano boutique in Saint-Priest (Auchan – Porte des Alpes), brand new, with the intention of making a substantial purchase for myself and for a collective gift.
at 6:41 p.m., while the store was wide open (curtain not lowered, doors accessible, no customers inside), the saleswoman said to me with a smile: “I’m closing the cash register, sorry ma’am, we’re closed.” However, the official times displayed on the kiko website indicate closing at 8:00 p.m.

as a loyal customer, used to making major purchases at kiko, I find this incomprehensible and disappointing. This experience definitely dissuaded me from frequenting this store.

ciao a tutti e voglio raccontare la mia esperienza negativa con kiko milano.
un giorno porto il mio cv di persona e subito dopo vengo chiamata per un colloquio. 
dopo il colloquio vengo illusa e scartata. 
mi cercano loro dopo un po' di mesi perché avevano tenuto il mio cv  per solo periodo natalizio, dopo il colloquio ennesimo scarto e mi fanno capire che era perché non avevo esperienza. 
decido di chiudere con kiko milano e non mandarne più.
dopo 1 anno e mezzo mando su linkedin nello stesso posto che portai il mio cv di persona e che feci i miei due colloqui.
stavolta il colloquio era online, lo feci e mi fa la domanda se avessi preferenze di quali delle due sedi di ... volessi lavorare e io le risposi che non avevo preferenze. 
mi illude dicendomi a fine colloquio che mi faceva sapere un feedback in settimana sia in positivo e sia negativo. 
spariti... 
contatto chi mi fece il colloquio dicendogli che volevo avere un feedback e mi dice che nel pomeriggio me lo darà, ovviamente era una presa in giro.
dalla rabbia la ricontatto e non risponde e gli lascio un messaggio in segreteria telefonica e poi mi si dà il feedback per messaggio dopo averle rotto io le scatole dicendomi che non avrebbero portato avanti la mia selezione.
dimostrando pure di essere aperta, interessata al lavoro non facendo preferenze,  mi hanno voluta illudere di nuovo, scartandomi e facendomi perdere tempo ed energie. 
mai più manderò cv a kiko, sono una azienda poco seria che assume i raccomandati e non chi ci mette la faccia e dimostra interesse e disponibilità al lavoro.
vergogna!
non portate il cv da kiko perché se non avete conoscenze trovano una scusa per scartati.

if i could give xero stars i would.
i originally purchased a kiko hydra balm foundation on 02 shell from amazon. it was the absolute perfect t foundation for me.  when the tube was almost empty, i reordered 4 of this item from kiko milano uk direct.  after 30 days of receiving the order i opened the first tube. to my horror on application it would not apply to my face, congealing into what seemed like 2 separate products and leaving white shiny patches on my face and white bits, almost like bits of tissue, and left my face burning and red. i tried one of the other tubes, to find it the same. on examining the code on these 2 tubes i found it to be different from the one i purchased from amazon. 
i tried contacting kiko but couldn’t find a phone number or email address. i eventually called their store in the trafford centre in manchester and their store manager, waide, filled out an online form for me over the phone.
eventually i received an email reply asking me to return the order, with instructions how to do this online. i tried to do this but their system kept taking me to a blank page. i have emailed them twice about this and am still waiting for a response. 
the worst customer service i have ever received.
just received this response to my third email advising them that there is an issue with their website that will not allow me to progress my return further. 
unbelievable! 

thank you for contacting us. in reference to your request 01513826, we kindly inform you that we have return policy in case of damaged, faulty and incorrect items.

if you have not passed our return policy on the website there is nothing that we can do.

we apologize for inconvenience.

we remain at your disposal and thank you for choosing kiko milano.

have a pleasant day,

dorota
kiko milano customer service

ho acquistato, come spesso accade, prodotti on line utilizzando per la prima volta il servizio del ritiro in negozio. esperienza pessima!!! l'ordine è stato registrato senza darmi la possibilità di pagare on line e chiedendomi il pagamento cash in negozio...fin qui nulla di irreparabile. i problemi sono cominciati quando però ho ricevuto la mail di invito a ritirare la merce in negozio entro 7 gg.
in negozio la commessa non ha potuto consegnarmi i prodotti ordinati perché c'erano anomalie nel processo di acquisto (pagamento in negozio per ordine effettuato on line). ha contattato in mia presenza l'assistenza per ricevere chiarimenti che non sono mai arrivati nonostante l'apertura di diversi ticket.
sono stata, infatti, in negozio altre 2 volte...l'ultima giovedì 10/07 per scoprire che l'ordine era misteriosamente scomparso...tant'è che non mi è stato possibile recuperare l'esatta data di acquisto (come richiesto dalla recensione)...orientativamente fine giugno.
inutile esprimere il mio disappunto...
la responsabile del negozio di rimini (c.so d'augusto) era palesemente mortificata e dispiaciuta per non aver avuto nessun riscontro ai suoi solleciti inviati all'azienda...alla fine ho proceduto con l'acquisto in negozio.
cortese, gentile e disponibile il personale in negozio...da rivedere, da parte dell'azienda, il servizio "ritira in negozio"...perché molto insodfisfacente!!!

recensione su kiko – centro commerciale le porte di napoli

esperienza a dir poco disastrosa. ho acquistato il mascara new maxi mod waterproof da kiko pensando di affidarmi a un prodotto di qualità. beh, è stato un errore madornale: questo mascara è talmente "resistente" che non viene via nemmeno con l'acido muriatico! altro che waterproof, è praticamente eterno sulla pelle. una vera tragedia cosmetica.
nonostante tutto, mi sono recata con molta educazione al negozio per chiedere un semplice cambio di prodotto, senza pretese: avrei anche speso di più o preso qualcosa di meno costoso senza discutere. ma niente. la commessa si è limitata a dire che il cambio non era possibile, senza offrire alcuna alternativa o soluzione.

un atteggiamento assolutamente irrispettoso verso un cliente che si era posto in maniera cortese e collaborativa. inaccettabile sotto ogni punto di vista.
prodotto pessimo.
mai più.

review_original:
un mal rato completamente innecesario

compré un pintalabios y, apenas 15 ó 20 minutos después, volví a la tienda para cambiar el tono. no lo había sacado ni de la caja.

la dependienta que me atendió, una chica morena de pelo largo, me acusó directamente de haberlo abierto, con bastante dureza y delante de otros clientes. intenté explicarle que no era así, pero su actitud fue muy desagradable, tanto en la forma de hablarme como en la manera de dirigirse a mí. me sentí juzgada, maltratada y tratada como si estuviera intentando engañarla.

llamó a la encargada, quien me atendió con educación y terminó cambiándome el producto. agradezco ese gesto, así como el trato correcto de otra trabajadora que también mantuvo la calma y la empatía en todo momento.

parece ser que el pintalabios ya estaba abierto cuando me lo vendieron, algo que yo desconocía por completo. y sin embargo, la forma en la que se me trató desde el primer momento fue ofensiva e innecesaria.

aclaro que esta experiencia fue en la tienda de la calle ercilla, en bilbao. no hablo del resto de tiendas, solo de lo que viví allí ese día.

no pienso volver. no por el producto, sino por la falta de respeto.

review_original: no sábado 22/02 fui a uma loja da marca em portugal comprar uma base e lá uma vendedora ofereceu ajuda e aceitei, até porque elas entendem mais do que eu. informei que minha pele é oleosa, que a base que usava em casa estava crackelando e ela me perguntou qual tipo de cobertura eu queria, disse que leve e para o dia a dia. então logo ela pegou uma base e me perguntou como estava minha pele naquele momento e disse começando a ficar oleosa e a mesma disse que não era oleosa, pois pele oleosa escorre e que provavelmente eu estaria usando produtos errados para pele e informei que não utilizo nada, somente água (quente) e sabão e não discordedei, mas sempre tive diagnóstico de que minha pele é oleosa. bom ela passou dois tons um em cada lado, me sugeriu uma e realmente tbm concordei com o tom ao olhar no espelho. ela sugeriu que limpasse um lado do rosto, pois iria passar um produto onde minha pele iria ficar melhor. passou o produto (um creme) e logo após passou a base novamentente sugerindo assim que minha pele estaria melhor, não vi diferença. solicitei um pó para selar a pele e na hora de escolher os produtos dei preferencia a base e ao pó, mas a mesma me indicou que era preferível comprar a base e o tal creme, pois minha pele estava precisando mais e que era pra passar todo dia, mesmo que não usasse maquiagem. comprei os dois produtos indicados, e um dia depois fui testar a base e utilizei o creme antes. a base é de alta cobertura deixando meu rosto horroroso pesado e esfarelando. fui lavar o rosto para tirar a base é de uma gordura imensa. ontem passei o tal creme de manha e a tarde fui lavar o rosto, estava com um sebo grosso e com espinhas internas por conta da oleosidade. no final comprei produtos inadequados para minha pele e só gastei dinheiro e obtive frustação com a marca.

i am shocked and disappointed by the way this incident has been handled. on 12th february at your westfield stratford city branch i spoke with fay a very helpful manager who agreed that i had been badly advised and sold a very bad colour match for my skin type. she said that if i return with the receipt she would refund the cost. she wrote and signed a note instructing staff to refund in case she was not in store when i returned.

i went back to the store on 14th february. a somewhat bewildered assistant took both the original receipt and fay’s note. she handed me a till printout that read exchange not refund and said the refund would be in my bank within 2 or 3 days. of course no refund has appeared thus far .  it is my opinion that she did not know how to refund and she also retained both my original receipt  and fay’s note.

yesterday 19th i phoned the store, spoke with yet another person who said he was a manager, had never heard of fay and was amazingly disinterested when i said i still had not been refunded.

it seems that the branch in question has no regular full time manager , so no continuity when queries arise.

kiko i have used your products for many years and introduced others to kiko but this service has left me feeling that it is time to buy my cosmetics from another brand.

1. onlineshop

review_original: i love kiko products, however the delivery is shambolic. i placed an order on the 26th november. it is now 16th december. it wasn't shipped until the 6th dec and has been stuck in frankfurt germany since the 10th dec. i bought a selection of products as a christmas gift for my sister, who was visiting on the weekend of the 14th dec (i thought i had placed the order in plenty of time). now i have to post these to her, when all the other members of the family were given their gifts. when i contacted customer services, all i got back was here is your tracking number.....doh, do you not think i have already looked at that? pathetic response. i will never place an order online with kiko again. think twice if you are thinking of placing an order online, you will be waiting a month for delivery and that's if you are lucky. i am still waiting for mine :-(

i first went into kiko in spain about 10 years ago.  i bought the eye primer which is the best i have found.  about 7 years ago i placed an on line order which took for ages to arrive and i complained.  

thinking that i would try an online order years later and that delivery must have improved i have been disappointed.  

so far ... 15 days!!!!  it didn't leave italy for 10 of these days and it has now been in germany for 3.  in this time i have posted a parcel to the united states and it has arrived safely.   

a little give and take for international delivery but why is my product even in germany when i am in the uk and why did it take 10 days to even pack it?  if i don't receive it this side of christmas i will be placing a complaint.... again.
